name: pv-battery-load-energy-challenge
purpose: Compare an independent executable FMI 3.0 co-simulation model with canonical energy semantics for PV generation, battery energy, load, initial repair draw and energy depletion.
status_claim: S5-V EXTERNAL EXECUTION — ESTABLISHED (SCOPED); S5-V ENDPOINT AGREEMENT — ESTABLISHED (SINGLE ENERGY CASE); S5-V TRAJECTORY-LEVEL CROSS-MODEL VALIDITY — NOT ESTABLISHED

negative_test.mutation: PV parameter forced +100 W in the native model
